name: ansible-skill
description: Diagnose-first Ansible and ansible-core guidance for idempotency, blast-radius controls, runtime safety, and CI/CD review.

interface.shortDescription: Ansible playbook, role, collection, and CI/CD guidance
interface.longDescription: Diagnose-first guidance for Ansible and ansible-core work. Reviews or generates playbooks, roles, collections, inventory, Vault usage, execution environments, testing, and CI/CD workflows with explicit idempotency evidence and blast-radius controls.
defaultPrompt: Review this Ansible playbook for idempotency and blast radius.
Write a safe Ansible role with Molecule validation.
Debug this Ansible execution environment or CI failure.
